item.title: Official entry info for Kenya was updated (Oct 28, 2026)
item.description: UK government note: "Updated information about Ebola screening, with details of how to access automated health information and guidance from the Kenyan authorities (‘Entry requirements’ page)." Updates like this can affect other passports too, so check the official entry rules for your passport before you book or travel. From The Escape Plan travel data. General information, not legal advice. Always check the official source before you travel.
